faults.why: Missing hiragana reading (わるい) for a kanji headword.
Missing essential A1/A2 senses: 'at fault / sorry' (私が悪かった, 悪いね) and 'unwell / bad for health' (体に悪い, 具合が悪い).
Using は without contrast here sounds unnatural; 天気が悪いです is the natural phrasing.
